《中考专刊》2026年9月刊 · 多模态文本阅读专项训练（一）讲评

多模态文本阅读 · 逐题精讲
本课件按 答案先显示 -> 材料原图（依据已用黄框划出）-> 逐题解析 组织。每篇 Exercise 先给本篇 6 题答案一览；材料原图上直接划出各题「文中依据」（黄框 + 题号角标），逐题卡片给出题干、选项（正确项高亮）、答案、文中依据与解析，依据处可点「回到原图」跳回原图相应依据框（会有加深提示）。

一、逐题讲解

Exercise 1 The Best Fruit Tea You Can Make at Home网页图文（食谱）· 应用文 · 难度：一星 · 6 题

主题：人与自我（生活与学习）
跳到题目123456
答案一览（先看答案，再读原文）
1B30 g sugar（配料清单）
2APut the pieces into the hot tea（步骤4）
3D茶包在热水中 2-3 分钟（步骤2）
4Bleave the fruit in the pot（步骤4括号）
5C排除 papayas / bananas（Note）
6A按步骤 1->5 排序
1. How much sugar should you prepare if you want to make this fruit tea?
A. 20 mL.B. 30 g.C. 1,200 mL.D. 3 to 4 g.
答案 B
文中依据 30 g sugar回到原图
解析 在 Things to get ready 配料清单里定位 sugar：30 g。A 的 20 mL 是柠檬汁、C 的 1,200 mL 是水、D 的 3~4 是茶包数——都是清单中其它材料的量，注意别张冠李戴。
2. According to the passage, what should you do right after cutting the fruit into small pieces?
A. Put the fruit pieces into the hot tea.B. Boil a pot of water.C. Put sugar and lemon juice into the pot.D. Leave the teabags in the hot water.
答案 A
文中依据 Put the pieces into the hot tea回到原图
解析 按 How to make 的步骤顺序读：第 3 步「切果」-> 第 4 步「把果块放进热茶」。B 烧水是第 1 步、C 放糖和柠檬汁是第 5 步，都不是切果之后紧接着做的。
3. According to the reading, which is correct when we make the fruit tea?
A. Boil water with sugar in it.B. Make sure to take out the fruit.C. Put in the fruit and the lemon juice at the same time.D. Leave the teabags in the pot of hot water for 2 to 3 minutes.
答案 D
文中依据 for 2 to 3 minutes and take them out回到原图
解析 D 与第 2 步「茶包放进热水 for 2 to 3 minutes」相合。A 错（先烧水，糖最后才放）；B 错（原文说 leave the fruit in the pot、并不要取出）；C 错（果块是第 4 步、糖和柠檬汁是第 5 步，不同时）。
4. What does the author suggest doing to make the fruit tea taste better?
A. Stirring the tea for less than 10 seconds.B. Keeping the fruit in the pot longer.C. Adding papayas or bananas to the tea.D. Boiling the fruit together with the teabags.
答案 B
文中依据 (Leave the fruit in the pot to make the tea taste better.)回到原图
解析 第 4 步括号内明确写 leave the fruit in the pot to make the tea taste better——把果块留在壶里更久才更好喝。A 与第 5 步「至少搅 10 秒」相反；C 的香蕉、木瓜见 Note 恰恰是不宜做水果茶的；D 原文是把果块放进热茶，不是与水同煮。
5. Amanda wants to make fruit tea according to the recipe. She has several kinds of fruit in the kitchen: apples, bananas, oranges, papayas, pears, and strawberries. Which of these fruits can she use to make the fruit tea?
A. Oranges, papayas and pears.B. Apples, bananas and oranges.C. Apples, oranges and strawberries.D. Bananas, papayas and strawberries.
答案 C
文中依据 not papayas or bananas回到原图
解析 Note 说 most fruits are good, but not papayas or bananas——先把香蕉、木瓜排除，六种里剩下 apples, oranges, pears, strawberries。逐项查：A 含木瓜、B 含香蕉、D 含香蕉和木瓜，都违 Note；只有 C 三项全部在可用之列。
6. Which of the following shows the correct order of making the fruit tea?
a. Take out the teabags.b. Stir the tea with sugar and lemon juice.c. Boil a pot of water.d. Put the fruit pieces into the hot tea.e. Put the teabags into the hot water.
A. c -> e -> a -> d -> bB. c -> a -> e -> d -> bC. e -> c -> a -> b -> dD. c -> e -> d -> a -> b
答案 A
文中依据 Boil a pot of water.回到原图 Put in sugar and lemon juice and stir for at least 10 seconds.回到原图
解析 把 a-e 对应回 How to make 的 5 个步骤：c 烧水(1) -> e 放茶包(2) -> a 捞出茶包(2) -> d 放果块(4) -> b 加糖柠檬汁搅(5)，即 c->e->a->d->b。

Exercise 2 Hawkins' Story（四格漫画）漫画（多模态）· 记叙 · 难度：二星 · 6 题

主题：人与社会（社会与自我）
跳到题目123456
答案一览（先看答案，再读原文）
1B计票板 HAWKINS 2
2Bbombed = 搞砸了（图2/图4标题）
3Bnot what a student leader can decide
4C一年没完成承诺的销量（图3）
5D反复吹牛（承诺做不到的事）
6C共同点：承诺不现实而失败
1. How many votes did Hawkins get when he ran for student leader?
A. 1.B. 2.C. 13.D. 25.
答案 B
文中依据 2回到原图
解析 图 2 的计票板上 HAWKINS 一行是 2 票（BRATT 25、HAHN 13 是别人的票数）。A 是「只卖了 1 辆车」、C 13 与 D 25 分别是 HAHN、BRATT 的票数。
2. What does it mean when we say someone bombed something?
A. They gave it up.B. They failed at it.C. They were fine with it.D. They were careful about it.
答案 B
文中依据 I totally bombed it.回到原图 I bombed it again.回到原图
解析 图 2 标题 I totally bombed it、图 4 标题 I bombed it again——他竞选落选、销售被辞，都是「搞砸了」，故选 failed at it。
3. Why did Hawkins' classmate say, “He doesn't know anything”?
A. Hawkins did not know how many days students go to school.B. Hawkins promised things that a student leader cannot actually choose to do.C. Hawkins forgot the name of the book he was holding in his hand.D. Hawkins did not know the results of the student leader vote.
答案 B
文中依据 What? That's not what a student leader can decide.回到原图
解析 同学的原话是 That's not what a student leader can decide——Hawkins 承诺「缩短课时、每周只上三天课」，这些学生干部根本无权决定，所以说他「什么都不懂」。
4. What was the boss's main reason for firing Hawkins from his sales job?
A. Hawkins packed his things and left the office early.B. Hawkins didn't show up for work for over two months.C. Hawkins failed to sell the number of cars he promised for over a year.D. Hawkins changed his mind and decided he wanted to be Number 1.
答案 C
文中依据 You said you would sell 50 cars a month. But you sold only 1 car in two months.回到原图 You said that a year ago.回到原图 Hawkins, we don't need your service anymore.回到原图
解析 老板说 you would sell 50 cars a month. But you sold only 1 car in two months，又说 You said that a year ago，最后 we don't need your service anymore——被辞的主因是一整年都没完成承诺的销量。A、B 原文未提。
5. According to the comics, what kind of person is Hawkins?
A. He sees good things in people.B. He never goes to work on time.C. He blindly follows other people.D. He talks about things he can't do.
答案 D
文中依据 I'll make class hours shorter. And we'll only have three days of school a week ...回到原图 Don't worry. I'll sell 149 cars next month.回到原图
解析 竞选时承诺「每周只上三天课」，销售时又说 I'll sell 149 cars next month——两处都属于「说些自己做不到的事」，故选 D。A、B、C 漫画均无依据。
6. Based on the comics, what do the stories from Hawkins' 6th grade and his age of 23 have in common?
A. In both stories, Hawkins won a big prize but lost it later.B. In both stories, Hawkins set realistic goals and worked hard for them.C. In both stories, Hawkins experienced failure due to making unrealistic promises.D. In both stories, Hawkins was forced to leave his school and his company.
答案 C
文中依据 I'll make class hours shorter. And we'll only have three days of school a week ...回到原图 I totally bombed it.回到原图 Don't worry. I'll sell 149 cars next month.回到原图 I bombed it again.回到原图
解析 两段的共同点是「都因许下不现实的承诺而失败」：6 年级承诺无权决定的事 -> 落选（2 票）；23 岁承诺卖车数 -> 一年未达标被辞。A「获奖又失去」、B「目标现实、努力奋斗」、D「被迫离开学校」（只是落选、并未退学）均不合。

Exercise 3 The Marigolds' Home（宣传册 + 地图）示意图 / 指南 · 应用文 · 难度：三星 · 6 题

主题：人与自我（生活与学习）
跳到题目123456
答案一览（先看答案，再读原文）
1B11-2月 10:00-16:00；周一闭馆
2Dgift shops 立减 30%
3A(1) 主门 -> (2) 蝴蝶园 -> (3) 游乐场
4DOpen times 板块提供开放时间
5D规则1：任何区域都禁带宠物
6C按地图：(5) 主屋 -> (8) 农场 -> (9) 玫瑰园
1. If you visit The Marigolds' Home on a Wednesday in December, what time does it close?
A. 10:00.B. 16:00.C. 17:00.D. It is closed all day.
答案 B
文中依据 November to February 10:00-16:00回到原图 Closed on Mondays回到原图
解析 12 月属 November to February，闭馆时间是 16:00；且周三不在 Closed on Mondays 之列，所以正常开放、16:00 关门。C 17:00 是 3-10 月的时间。
2. What benefit do you get if you become a member through their website?
A. Free tickets to the Main House.B. 10% off items in the gift shops.C. 30% off everything in the cafe.D. A 30% discount on items at the gift shops.
答案 D
文中依据 save 10% on tickets and 30% on all items in the gift shops回到原图
解析 原文 save 10% on tickets and 30% on all items in the gift shops——gift shops 的优惠是 30%。B 把 10% 误安到 gift shops 上（10% 是门票）；A 说门票免费、C 说咖啡店 30% 折，均无依据。
3. Look at the map. Which attraction is located directly between the Main Gate and the Playground?
A. Butterfly Garden.B. Family Library.C. Rose Garden.D. Cafe.
答案 A
文中依据 Butterfly Garden回到原图
解析 按图例编号和地图方位：(1) Main Gate 沿主路向内依次经过 (2) Butterfly Garden、(3) Playground，蝴蝶园正好夹在主门与游乐场之间。B 家庭图书馆在 (4)、C 玫瑰园在 (9)，位置都不符。
4. Which question can the brochure answer?
A. Can I order tickets online?B. How much are the tickets?C. How can I get to the Marigolds' Home?D. When can I visit the Marigolds' Home?
答案 D
文中依据 Opening times回到原图
解析 宣传册设有 Opening times 板块，能回答「什么时候可以参观」。票能否网上订购、票价多少、怎么到达，文中都没有信息，故 A、B、C 都不能答。
5. What breaks the rules for visitors to the Marigolds' Home?
A. Eating burgers in the Rose Garden.B. Taking pictures in the Main House.C. Entering the Rabbit's Temple without shoes.D. Taking pet dogs for a walk on the playground.
答案 D
文中依据 Pets are not allowed in any areas of the Marigolds' Home.回到原图
解析 规则 1 明确 Pets are not allowed in any areas，故带宠物狗在游乐场散步违规。A 在玫瑰园吃东西不违规（规则 2 只禁在建筑内饮食）；B 规则 3 禁拍的是 Sir Archie's House、不是 Main House；C 规则 4 要求进 Rabbit's Temple 脱鞋，「不穿鞋进入」其实是合规的。
6. After shopping at the gift shop of the Main House, Lizzy walks out and sees the Family Library in front of her. She wants to visit the Rose Garden. How can she get there?
A. Turn left and walk past the Main House, then go straight and turn right at the corner.B. Turn left and walk past Sir Archie's House, then turn right and walk past the Main House.C. Turn right and go straight to the Farmyard, then turn right and go straight before turning left at the corner.D. Turn right and walk through the Butterfly Garden, then walk past the Rabbit's Temple and the cafe.
答案 C
文中依据 Butterfly Garden回到原图 Family Library回到原图 Main House回到原图 Rose Garden回到原图
解析 据地图方位推理：人从(5) Main House 的礼品店出来、面前是(4) Family Library，向右走经(8) Farmyard，再直行到(9) Rose Garden 一带——与 C 的走法吻合。做题时先在图例上定好(4)(5)(8)(9)的位置，再逐句核对选项方向词（left / right / straight）。

Exercise 4 SEA GLASS: GLASS BOTTLES' SECOND LIFE图文说明（流程图）· 应用文 · 难度：三星 · 6 题

主题：人与自然（自然生态）
跳到题目123456
答案一览（先看答案，再读原文）
1Cpaper bowls and cups 更受欢迎
2Bsharp pieces slowly become round
3A图2：撞到彼此/垃圾 -> 碎裂
4C图4：数十年—数百年 -> 外层变白
5A玻璃用品变少 -> 海里玻璃少
6D碎瓶->海玻璃->用于艺术品（新生命）
1. Which items have become more popular than glass bottles and bowls these days?
A. Art pieces made of sea glass.B. Garbage thrown into the water.C. Paper cups and paper bowls.D. Ice-like white glass items.
答案 C
文中依据 However, people now seldom use glass to make bottles and bowls — paper bowls and cups have become more popular these days.回到原图
解析 末段说 paper bowls and cups have become more popular these days——比玻璃瓶碗更受欢迎的是纸碗纸杯。A、D 是海玻璃及其成品，B 是丢进海里的垃圾，都不是「更受欢迎」的对象。
2. What happens to the sharp edges of the glass pieces as they move along the sea floor?
A. They turn into paper cups and bowls.B. They slowly become round and rounder.C. They grow an ice-like white color immediately.D. They get pushed deeper into the sand and disappear.
答案 B
文中依据 The sharp pieces slowly become round and rounder.回到原图
解析 第 3 步说 The sharp pieces slowly become round and rounder——尖锐的玻璃随海水滚动被磨圆。C 的变白发生在第 4 步且需数十年到数百年，不是立即；A、D 均无依据。
3. According to the diagram, what makes the broken glass bottles break into even smaller pieces?
A. They hit each other or other garbage while riding the waves.B. They are cut into pieces by artists who collect them.C. They are broken by people who throw them from the beach.D. They hit the sharp rocks on the sea floor.
答案 A
文中依据 they hit each other or other garbage in the sea and break into small pieces of glass回到原图
解析 第 2 步写明 when these bottles ride the waves, they hit each other or other garbage and break into small pieces——是随浪互相撞击或被别的垃圾撞碎。D 的「海底礁石」原文未提；B 艺术家是第 6 步收集成品，C 从海滩扔也没有依据。
4. According to the reading, how is sea glass formed?
A. Sea glass becomes rounder after it is pushed up to the beach.B. Colder sea water helps pieces of glass become sea glass faster.C. Pieces of glass become white on the outside after many years in the sea.D. Glass bottles break into small pieces when they are dug out from the sea floor.
答案 C
文中依据 After tens or hundreds of years in the sea, the pieces of glass grow an ice-like white color on the outside and become sea glass.回到原图
解析 第 4 步是海玻璃形成的关键：after tens or hundreds of years in the sea, the pieces grow an ice-like white color on the outside and become sea glass。A 把「磨圆」的发生地错放在被冲上海滩之后；B 的「更冷的海水更快」原文未提；D 的「从海底挖出」不对。
5. According to the reading, why will less sea glass be found in the future?
A. People do not make as many glass items as before.B. People have learned not to throw garbage into the sea.C. Artists are using too much sea glass in their art pieces.D. Waves are not big enough to push sea glass up to the beach.
答案 A
文中依据 fewer glass items in the sea, so less and less sea glass will be found in the future回到原图
解析 末段因果链：people now seldom use glass to make bottles and bowls -> there are fewer glass items in the sea -> less sea glass will be found。B「人们不再往海里扔垃圾」过于绝对且非原文；C、D 均无依据。
6. Why does the title say “Glass Bottles' Second Life”?
A. People collect sea glass and use it to make new glass bottles.B. People collect sea glass at the beach and use it to make wishes.C. Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become the homes of sea animals.D. Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become sea glass which is used in art pieces.
答案 D
文中依据 Artists collect pieces of sea glass and put them into their works.回到原图
解析 题眼在「second life（第二次生命）」：开头说 glass bottles that are thrown into the water，第 6 步说 Artists collect pieces of sea glass and put them into their works——被丢弃的玻璃瓶变成海玻璃、再被艺术家用进作品，正是「第二次生命」。A 说做新玻璃瓶、B 说许愿、C 说成为海洋动物的家，均不合。

二、答案速查

多模态文本阅读专项训练（一）· Exercise 1-4 答案一览
Exercise123456
第 1 篇BADBCA
第 2 篇BBBCDC
第 3 篇BDADDC
